{{Quote|Glorious first outing for the crusading Jedi volunteers, wouldn't you say?|Ferroh|<ref name="kotor8" />}}
In [[3964 BBY]], a group of [[Revanchist]]s&mdash;crusading [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who defied the orders of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and left to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] with the invading [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans&mdash;were '''ambushed''' on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Suurja]] while on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission. Located on the front lines of the Mandalorian invasion, Suurja had recently played host to [[First battle of Suurja|several]] [[Second battle of Suurja|heated]], [[Third battle of Suurja|stalemated]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|battles]] between the Mandalorians and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. When the Revanchists arrived on Suurja, their leader, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known only as [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], left them behind to continue his investigations on other worlds. Soon afterward, they were attacked by a team of [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rohlan Dyre]]. The Revanchists were captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] at the Mandalorian-held [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station|Flashpoint Station]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I will not remove your mask until there is justice&mdash;until the Mandalorians have been defeated once and for all. So swears&hellip; ''Revan!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Revan, beginning the Revanchist movement|<ref name="kotor42">[[Knights of the Old Republic 42|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 42]]</ref>}}
In [[3976 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], a fighting force formed from the ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] clans, began to carve out an empire through military conquest on the farthest reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. After subjugating a number of unaligned [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], Mandalorian [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|chief]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] set his true plan in motion, moving against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by contesting resource worlds near the Outer Rim [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="tea">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In an effort to defend Taris, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] set up a defensive cordon in the region known as the [[Jebble-Vanquo-Tarnith line]]. One of the worlds along the line was the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Suurja]], which, in the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of what became known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], played host to [[First battle of Suurja|four]] [[Second battle of Suurja|successive]] [[Third battle of Suurja|stalemated]] [[Fourth battle of Suurja|battles]] between the Republic and Mandalorians in [[3964 BBY]].<ref name="prime" />

Amidst the violence on the Outer Rim, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] counseled caution and decided against jumping into the war.<ref name="kotor9" /> However, one [[Revanchist|group]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], led by a charismatic young [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known simply as [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], refused to listen to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council's]] directive and vowed to fight the Mandalorians.<ref name="kotor42" /> The Revanchists, as they were called, visited Suurja on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission, accompanied by Revan himself.<ref name="kotor9" />

==The ambush==
{{Quote|Captured on Suurja&mdash;ambushed. We were just going to look around, but it's like they knew we were coming.|Ferroh|<ref name="kotor8" />}}
After a short [[Time/Legends|time]] on Suurja, Revan left to investigate Mandalorian activity on the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. However, by the time he departed, some of the Revanchist Knights and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who had accompanied him to Suurja began to disappear.<ref name="kotor9" /> Soon, with their leader gone, the Revanchists were ambushed by [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rohlan Dyre]]&mdash;the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi [[Ferroh]] remarked that it was as if the Mandalorians knew they were coming. The Mandalorians captured and took a number of the Revanchists [[Prison/Legends|prisoner]], including Revan's apprentice and close friend, [[Darth Malak|Alek]], and Jedi Knight Ferroh.<ref name="kotor8" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You will find them and bring them ''directly'' back here, ''no diversion, no delay!'' There was no place for the Order in the wrangling over the Outer Rim, and there is certainly no place for it in a wider Mandalorian war!|Jedi Council member [[Vrook Lamar]], to Revan, after the ambush|<ref name="kotor9" />}}
After the ambush, the captured Jedi were taken to [[Flashpoint Stellar Research Station|Flashpoint Station]], a remote [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that the Mandalorians had seized in the early days of the war. There, they were experimented upon by the Mandalorian [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Demagol]], who was determined to discover the source of their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] to find the best way to negate or replicate them.<ref name="kotor8" /> On the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] castigated Revan after he returned from Onderon and Dxun&mdash;the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] were furious over his inclusion of other Knights and Padawans on his scouting missions, which the Council did not support. Although Revan was ordered to find the missing Jedi and bring them back,<ref name="kotor9" /> the Revanchists were soon rescued by former Jedi Padawan [[Zayne Carrick]] and his friends.<ref name="kotor10">[[Knights of the Old Republic 10|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 10]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ambush on Suurja first appeared in a flashback in [[Knights of the Old Republic 6|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 6]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]]<ref name="kotor6" /> released on [[June 28]], [[2006]],<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/12-892/Star-Wars-Knights-of-the-Old-Republic-6|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #6}}</ref> written by [[John Jackson Miller]], and illustrated by [[Brian Ching]].<ref name="kotor6" />
